item.title: There's no reason for software to be slow anymore
item.description:
📝 JIT compilers are a great example of that. Recall that it was created by having an agent loop for a month on improving regex engine performance with access to the rebar regex benchmark suite. There's no particular reason to use a "software factory" regex engine that doesn't beat a well-tested regex engine on holdout benchmarks, but one notable thing about FRE was that the native AOT compiled version did quite well at longer searches.
🔗 Read more: https://danluu.com/perf-opt/

item.title: Rust Glancer: Rust LSP using 100x less RAM
item.description:
📝 rust-analyzer uses rowan for syntax tree representation. This is the core idea of Rust Glancer. It doesn't come for free though: frozen workspace analysis is slower than lazy incremental by definition, since loading and deserializing data from filesystem is slower than loading from memory.
🔗 Read more: https://rust-glancer.github.io/blog/hello-world/

item.title: Early Humans Likely Ate Carbs and Sugary Foods
item.description:
📝 Dental evidence has suggested that early humans ate plenty of fruit. Dental evidence has suggested that early humans ate plenty of fruit. Another clue that early humans and other ancient primates ate a lot of natural sugar in their diet is that most of them had cavities.
🔗 Read more: https://www.history.com/articles/early-human-ancestors-diet-sugar-carbs
